expectations.text: Uses states() rather than variant() since the flags are independent, not mutually exclusive
expectations.evidence: states({ base, selected, disabled }) — correct, with a comment explicitly explaining why states() over variant().

expectations.text: Does not hand-write a separate combined selected+disabled branch
expectations.evidence: Only base/selected/disabled blocks exist; both apply simultaneously via states()'s layering, no combined branch.

expectations.text: Colors are semantic tokens, not raw hex
expectations.evidence: background, border-primary, text, background-hover, background-selected, primary — all semantic tokens.
